_about: Filter Compatibility Rules — edit me freely. The app reloads this on every filter load.

_rule_schema.description: human-readable explanation of what this rule does/why
_rule_schema.pattern: command name (for command/allow) OR regex pattern (for regex)
_rule_schema.replacement: full new line text (no leading indent or newline — both preserved automatically). Supports $1/$2 backrefs in regex mode.
_rule_schema.rename_to: alternative to replacement: just the new command name; keeps args + comments intact
_rule_schema.kind: rename | deprecated | replace | remove (cosmetic label only, used for grouping in the UI)

rules.description: Example: rename a hypothetical OldSoundCommand to CustomAlertSound.
Example: replace `DisableDropSound True` (legacy boolean form) with the bare command.
Example: strip out any line using a command the game removed.
Example: tell the validator a new condition is legal. Add one of these whenever GGG ships a new command so it stops being flagged as 'unknown'.
